notes.title: What is a Roll-a-Mech?
notes.notes: [p][b]Reflex Unit: Strike Ops has just passed 1,000 downloads![/b][/p][p]To celebrate this milestone, I wanted to share a little behind-the-scenes look at one of the more unusual vehicles you’ll encounter later in the game: the [b]Roll-a-Mech[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Reflex Unit: Strike Ops is my first Steam release, though I’ve previously developed games for Mobile, Switch, and Meta Quest. One of my favorites to work on was a single and multiplayer Meta Quest VR mech game called [b]Roll-a-Mech[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]The name came from the classic Unity tutorial [url="https://learn.unity.com/project/roll-a-ball"][i]Roll-a-Ball[/i][/url], which many Unity developers will recognize. My version reimagines that idea as a [url="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tachikoma"][i]Tachikoma[/i][/url]-inspired robot, with an open cockpit design so players can enjoy a full 360° view from inside.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/ae37c70f367aa27f5e241594e3076da2d73449d9.gif"][/img][/p][p]One of the Roll-a-Mech’s signature features is its legs: they can retract and raise, allowing the mech to roll forward at high speed![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/dca86a4047f64492383038659649fa8e6079f0a3.gif"][/img][/p][p]In [b]Reflex Unit: Strike Ops[/b] (Stage 10 and in Versus Mode), you’ll get the chance to pilot an early prototype of the Roll-a-Mech for yourself.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/440ecec074fb6a34d62fcc45be8094bdfd8accef.gif"][/img][/p][p]3D Print Model of Roll-a-Mech[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/6fd708f889adb216df9f2188c4a1013fce42fb5c.png"][/img]Blue Print of a Roll-a-Mech[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/cdf97116aa797705c7871670f672b154b912e5db.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thanks for joining me on this little detour from the usual release notes—I hope you enjoyed learning more about the Roll-a-Mech![/p][p][/p][p]Until next time![/p][p][/p][p]Alex[/p][p]Robosaru Games[/p]

notes.title: Post Release Update
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]It’s been a few weeks since the launch of [b][i]Reflex Unit : Strike Ops[/i][/b] and I wanted to share an update on the fixes and improvements that have been rolled out since then based on your valuable feedback. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Current version 1.0.5[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/p][list][*][p]Aim Assist Option (Gameplay Menu).[/p][/*][*][p]Gamepad Analog Stick can control aim distant (when Aim Assist is Off).[/p][/*][*][p]Mouse aiming improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]Aim Dots can be disabled/enabled (Video Menu).[/p][/*][*][p]Music, VO and Sound FX volume level controls are now more adjustable.[/p][/*][*][p]DirectX 11 is now available as an optional render engine in Windows with support for Exclusive Full Screen mode (which [i]may[/i] give better performance than the default Vulkan engine). [/p][p]To enable DirectX 11, add the following to the Launch Options in Properies > General:[/p][p][b]-force-d3d11[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]FIXES[/b][/p][list][*][p]CO-OP Mode networking fixes for objectives across clients.[/p][/*][*][p]Various Japanese Language fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]On some systems that do not support Vulkan the game would not start (DX11 added as fallback render engine).[/p][/*][*][p]Game would sometimes unpause when inside settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Trucks would sometimes collide.[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements would sometimes trigger incorrectly.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Please continue to share any issues or improvment suggestions you have for the game in the discussion forum and I will do my best to follow up with them.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing![/p][p][/p][p]Alex[/p][p]Robosaru Games[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Reflex Unit: Strike Ops Demo - May 2025 Update
notes.notes:
We’re excited to roll out a fresh update for the Reflex Unit: Strike Ops demo, with some new features and enhancements:

[list]
[*][b]More Destruction![/b] Now even more of the NEOTECH facilities can be destroyed, with more bombastic explosions. Looks out for pickups in the rubble!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/ad41cd4363c31ec3d0761550041e197c3e6b099a.gif[/img]

[*][b]Improved Flight Model![/b] Your helicopters now control more realistically with physics based intertia. The Scout Chopper is quick and nimble, the Cargo Chopper is heavy and more challenging to control and the Rescue Chopper is a good all rounder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/1e01b4b7cca55c70037eb410d2e5b9feaeb2856c.gif[/img]

[*][b]Air Drops![/b] You can now call in Ammo, Armor and Fuel air drops in the field for yourself, or you and your friends to use when playing co-op mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/c549c793199f091033cc4ed262499f9a56b39182.gif[/img]
[/list]

Jump back in and check out the new features. We’d love your feedback!

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who tried out the Strike Ops [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3186100/Reflex_Unit__Strike_Ops_Demo/]Demo [/url]during Steam Fest! The demo is still available, so if you missed it, no worries – it's here to stay!

Based on your incredible feedback, we’ve made several improvements to enhance the Strike Ops experience:

[b]Building Explosions[/b]
Now, when you take down the evil NEOTECH bases, they explode and crumble with dynamic physics!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/6296083b2465fbf56621da41467a32b9f0af70a8.gif[/img]

[b]Tuned Container Carrying[/b]
Carrying containers now incurs a significantly reduced movement penalty, so you can move faster and stay nimble.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/bcfa7589467131c662ca3cde6542379cfe416e22.gif[/img]

[b]Increased Enemy Presence[/b]
The NEOTECH forces received reinforcements and a software update to enhance their area control – expect more action in the AO!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/e07805521f16f6e15a8db104d8f54db7009a82f3.gif[/img]

[b]Remappable Controls[/b]
Customize your controls! Gamepad and Keyboard/Mouse layouts can now be configured to match your play style in the settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/3ccb044508cfdbdb0bae3a3300e7caf613c1a464.gif[/img]

[b]Adjustable Camera[/b]
Adjust the Field of View (FOV) of the camera to your preference in the settings for an optimized view.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/1d89e08f5577c540bcac655546dd95a3a8b68460.gif[/img]

[b]Disable Pause During Conversations[/b]
There’s now an option to disable auto-pause during conversations, so you can stay immersed in the action.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/a103d8419bbcade176c35bd2d54921342b63a254.gif[/img]

[b]Show All Objectives[/b]
You can now display all objectives on the map at once, giving you more flexibility to plan your mission strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/e8e826cfe271f14b472ac170f0df6f82d02ce8f4.gif[/img]

[b]Change Vehicle[/b]
Swap your vehicle at any time by returning to the aircraft carrier – perfect for when you need a fresh approach.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/69067ade46f0a696c710c883033481701e6dac6e.gif[/img]

[b]Special Surprise[/b]
At the end of the demo, watch out for a surprise appearance from a new contraption from one of NEOTECH's advanced research facilities…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/cfadc7f47fe792465953293e951f1101c474d6af.gif[/img]

Additionally, don’t forget that online co-op is available in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2992700/view/4522268823008022326?l=english]BETA [/url]branch, so invite some friends for some Strike Ops action together!

notes.title: Online Coop Beta Testing
notes.notes:
Hello, Pilots!

We hope you're enjoying the preview of Reflex Unit: Strike Ops after playing the recently released [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3186100/Reflex_Unit__Strike_Ops_Demo/]demo[/url]. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we’re excited to incorporate many of your suggestions as we work toward the final release in 2025, making it the best it can be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/44aee8fbf8fd4e0898c1b5d90d4f517afdf98e95.gif[/img]

In the meantime, we invite you to try out a special version of the demo that features online co-op mode! To access this, simply navigate to [b]Properties > Betas[/b] and select the [b]online_coop[/b] Beta Branch. As this is a Beta version, there may still be some issues, and we’d greatly appreciate your feedback and suggestions for improvement—[i]feel free to share them in the comments below.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/d0dd8eb04439538c65bc41aa89411ff1d14042bc.jpg[/img]

[b]How to Start a Co-op Session:[/b]
Launch the demo as usual, and before selecting your aircraft, switch to the online mode in the lower-left corner of the screen. You’ll be able to choose from Americas, APAC, or European regions, and you can join either a public or private (password-protected) session.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/61887e582211e13f3f4b68cd349d090e84174e75.gif[/img]

[b]For Private Sessions:[/b]
To set up a private game, simply choose a session code and share it with the players you want to team up with. Make sure all players select the same code and region, and you’ll be able to play together seamlessly.

Let us know how your co-op missions go, and happy flying!

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.notes:
[p]We have been testing Reflex Unit : Strike Ops regularly on Steam Deck since the beginning of development, and believe the game is 100% compatible, and plays fantastic on the device!
[/p][p]For anyone playing on Steamdeck, we recommend to set the following in game[/p][p][b]Settings > Video[/b][/p][p]- Frame Rate : Uncapped FPS[/p][p]- Anti Aliasing : Balanced[/p][p]- FOV and UI Size : As you prefer[/p][p][/p][p]Then in [b]Steam Performance Overlay[/b], set [b]Frame Limit 60 FPS (60hz)[/b].
[/p][previewyoutube="k5z9CpXM4aQ;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Update

We're thrilled by the feedback you've shared on Reflex Unit: Strike Ops since the demo launch last week!

[list]
[*] Adjustable FOV for a more customizable experience.
[*] Increased enemy variety and presence to amp up the challenge.
[*] Option to disable automatic pausing during communications.
[*] Enhanced Lock function UI for smoother gameplay.
[*] Graphic improvements, including V-Sync enabled by default.
[*] Plus, various other fixes and optimizations.
[/list]

Please keep your feedback coming! We're committed to making Reflex Unit: Strike Ops the best it can be, with the full release planned for early 2025, including online versus and co-op multiplayer!
